content.value_statement: Legacy modernization is risky when teams replace too much at once. This skill guides staged migration with assessment, testing, rollout, and decommissioning steps.
actual_capabilities: Creates assessment prompts for technical debt, dependencies, security issues, and component complexity.
Guides dependency mapping, business impact scoring, and migration priority planning.
Defines test coverage, contract testing, and test data management activities before refactoring.
Outlines strangler fig infrastructure, feature flags, routing, circuit breakers, and observability needs.
Plans rollout monitoring, rollback triggers, documentation, and legacy component decommissioning.
limitations: It provides workflow guidance, not runnable migration automation.
It depends on project-specific inputs such as architecture, traffic, dependencies, and compliance requirements.
It references specialized agents that may not exist in every AI environment.
Teams must validate all outputs with tests, security review, and production monitoring.

use_cases.title: Plan a staged modernization roadmap
use_cases.description: Convert a legacy system inventory into prioritized migration phases with risk scoring and rollback planning.

use_cases.title: Design progressive rollout controls
use_cases.description: Define feature flags, routing rules, monitoring dashboards, and rollback thresholds for parallel system operation.

use_cases.title: Establish migration safety checks
use_cases.description: Create characterization tests, contract tests, test data processes, and security review steps before modernization work starts.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a legacy service
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner discovery for one service or module.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to assess the legacy service at [path or system name]. Identify technical debt, risky dependencies, missing tests, and quick modernization wins.

prompt_templates.title: Build a migration roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to turn our component inventory into a modernization roadmap. Include business impact, dependency risks, migration order, and rollback needs.

prompt_templates.title: Design strangler rollout controls
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced rollout planning for parallel systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a strangler fig rollout. Specify routing, feature flags, monitoring, traffic stages, success metrics, and automatic rollback triggers.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate full modernization delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to coordinate an end-to-end legacy modernization program. Cover assessment, tests, implementation waves, security hardening, rollout, and decommissioning.

output_examples.input: A team wants to modernize a monolithic billing service without downtime.
output: A phased assessment covering dependencies, revenue impact, data sensitivity, and test coverage gaps.
A first migration wave focused on low-risk billing read operations behind feature flags.
A rollout plan with traffic stages, latency checks, error thresholds, and rollback owners.

output_examples.input: A platform group needs safeguards before routing traffic to a new API layer.
output: Recommended contract tests for API consumers and integration points.
Monitoring needs for legacy and modern paths during parallel operation.
Rollback criteria based on error rates, latency, and business metric degradation.

output_examples.input: A security lead asks how modernization can reduce legacy risk.
output: A review plan for authentication, authorization, input validation, secrets handling, and OWASP top 10 coverage.
A migration checkpoint requiring security verification before each traffic increase.
Documentation requirements for retained legacy components and sunset timelines.

best_practices: Start with current behavior tests before changing legacy code.
Move traffic gradually and define rollback triggers before each release.
Document architecture decisions, ownership, and retained legacy dependencies.
anti_patterns: Replacing a critical system in one large release without parallel validation.
Modernizing components before understanding data coupling and integration contracts.
Treating generated plans as production approval without local testing and review.

faq.question: What modernization approach does this skill use?
faq.answer: It focuses on the strangler fig pattern, where new components gradually replace legacy behavior.

faq.question: Can it migrate code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured prompts, plans, checkpoints, and review guidance for human-led modernization.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the system scope, code locations, dependency information, business constraints, traffic patterns, and current test coverage.

faq.question: Does it include testing guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers characterization tests, contract tests, test data management, and performance baselines.

faq.question: How should teams validate the output?
faq.answer: Teams should review plans with system owners, run tests, confirm security controls, and monitor production rollout metrics.
